_about: Literature ledger for this result (docs/research/publication.md, rule 3). Every number the summary quotes from a paper is here, with the table, the version read and whether it was checked against the version of record. Before any submission every entry must have checked_vor = true. Values in parentheses in Wu's Table II are standard deviations of the simulation, not errors of a mean.

wu2006_spcfw_table2.quantity: bulk properties of SPC/Fw water, simulation at 298.15 K and 1 atm (216 molecules, 6.5 ns); the value in brackets is the quoted standard deviation
wu2006_spcfw_table2.source: Y. Wu, H. L. Tepper, G. A. Voth, J. Chem. Phys. 124, 024503 (2006)
wu2006_spcfw_table2.location: Table II, column SPC/Fw; the inaccuracy of eta is stated in the table caption
wu2006_spcfw_table2.version_read: publisher PDF (AIP, 'Research article' header, as filed in ../Lit)
wu2006_spcfw_table2.note: Whether Ds is corrected for the box size is not stated in the text read; the comparison in the summary assumes it is not.

wu2006_spcfw_protocol.quantity: simulation protocol of the SPC/Fw run behind Table II
wu2006_spcfw_protocol.source: Wu, Tepper, Voth, J. Chem. Phys. 124, 024503 (2006)
wu2006_spcfw_protocol.location: Sec. II B and the text around Table II

yeh_hummer2004_finite_size.quantity: finite-size correction of the self-diffusion coefficient in a cubic periodic box, D_inf = D_PBC + k_B T xi / (6 pi eta L), xi = 2.837297
yeh_hummer2004_finite_size.source: I.-C. Yeh, G. Hummer, J. Phys. Chem. B 108, 15873 (2004)
yeh_hummer2004_finite_size.location: Eq. 1 and the value of xi for a cubic box
yeh_hummer2004_finite_size.version_read: formula taken from the ucmd-analysis constants module, which cites it; the paper itself was not re-read for this ledger
